item.text: [{"task_id":"4938f0c2","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    foreground = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    anchor = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    unit = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    divisor = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if background == foreground or foreground == anchor or background == anchor or divisor == 0:","        return np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    centers = np.argwhere(grid == anchor)","    points = np.argwhere(grid == foreground)","    if len(centers) == 0 or len(points) == 0:","        return np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    row_sum = int(np.min(centers[:, 0]) + np.max(centers[:, 0]))","    col_sum = int(np.min(centers[:, 1]) + np.max(centers[:, 1]))","    for point in points:","        row = int(point[0])","        col = int(point[1])","        for row_weight in params['directions']:","            row_sign = int(round(row_weight))","            target_row = row_sign * row + (unit - row_sign) * row_sum // divisor","            for col_weight in params['directions']:","                col_sign = int(round(col_weight))","                target_col = col_sign * col + (unit - col_sign) * col_sum // divisor","                if 0 <= target_row < grid.shape[0] and 0 <= target_col < grid.shape[1]:","                    if out[target_row, target_col] == background:","                        out[target_row, target_col] = foreground","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[2],"directions":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,3],"geometry":[1,2],"directions":[1,-1]},"rationale":"Complete the red pattern by reflecting every red cell horizontally and vertically about the center of the green square. Preserve existing cells. The tensors encode background, pattern and anchor colors, reflection arithmetic, and both reflection signs."}]
